verifications.claim: NASA currently targets early 2028 for the launch of Artemis IV.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Artemis IV Early 2028 (planned)'; R2: 'Artemis IV (early 2028)'; R3: 'Early 2028 (planned)'; R6: 'Artemis IV – early 2028'; R7: 'Artemis IV: Scheduled launch is early 2028'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state early 2028 target for Artemis IV launch.

verifications.claim: Artemis IV will be the first crewed lunar landing since Apollo 17, according to NASA's official mission overview.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'First lunar landing of the Artemis program'; R2: 'first American crewed lunar landing since Apollo 17'; R3: 'first crewed landing on the Moon since Apollo 17'; R8: 'Humanity's return to the lunar surface'
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly confirm Artemis IV as first crewed lunar landing since Apollo 17; R8 is NASA site.

verifications.claim: Artemis IV will use the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket to send astronauts to the lunar south pole.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'SLS Block 1 Crew'; R2: 'Space Launch System (SLS) rocket will send an Orion spacecraft'; R3: 'Space Launch System (SLS) rocket'; R8: 'near the South Pole of the Moon'
verifications.reasoning: SLS confirmed for Artemis IV crew launch to lunar orbit/orbiting lander for south pole; south pole specified in NASA source.

verifications.claim: Artemis IV will contribute to building the Gateway station.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Lunar Gateway (cancelled)'; 'before the Lunar Gateway was cancelled in February 2026'; R3: no Gateway mention; R4: outdated 'deliver the first ESA module for the Gateway: I-Hab'
verifications.reasoning: Recent sources confirm Gateway cancelled; Artemis IV now first landing mission, not Gateway delivery.

verifications.claim: Artemis IV's mission goal is the second human lunar landing of the Artemis program, following Artemis III.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Artemis III ... Crewed orbital mission'; 'Artemis IV ... First lunar landing'; R2: 'Artemis III (mid-2027) ... Crewed test of HLS in low Earth orbit'; 'Artemis IV ... first lunar landing'; R3: 'first lunar landing'
verifications.reasoning: Sources state Artemis IV as first Artemis lunar landing; Artemis III is orbital test, not landing.

verifications.claim: Artemis IV's launch site is Kennedy Space Center, Launch Complex 39B.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Kennedy Space Center, LC-39B'; R3: 'Kennedy, LC‑39B'
verifications.reasoning: Direct match for exact launch site in multiple sources.

verifications.claim: Astronauts on Artemis IV will dock with the Lunar Gateway in orbit.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Lunar Gateway (cancelled)'; Artemis IV docks with lander, not Gateway
verifications.reasoning: Gateway cancelled per sources; Artemis IV docks with HLS lander in lunar orbit.

verifications.claim: Astronauts on Artemis IV will descend to the lunar surface for about a week of research.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'descend to the lunar surface and conduct extravehicular activities'; R8: 'descend to the surface and spend approximately a week near the South Pole ... conducting new science'
verifications.reasoning: NASA source directly supports ~week surface stay for research/science.

verifications.claim: Artemis IV follows the crewed lunar landing scheduled for 2027 (Artemis III).
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Artemis III NET 2027 (planned) ... Crewed orbital mission'; R2: 'Artemis III (mid-2027) ... Crewed test of HLS in low Earth orbit'
verifications.reasoning: Artemis III is orbital/Earth orbit test, not lunar landing.

verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Artemis III NET 2027 (planned)'; R2: 'Artemis III (mid-2027)'; R6: 'Artemis III – 2027'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources confirm 2027 schedule for Artemis III.
